note: Authentic DhumketuX visual assets for the redesign concept. Every file originates from a DhumketuX-controlled source (dhumketux.com uploads, DhumketuX-published media) surfaced via public web image search. No third-party hardware imagery is presented as DhumketuX hardware. Renders published by DhumketuX are labeled as renders.
